gaps.summary: Nothing checks that a request came from Paylane, so anyone who finds the public URL can post a fake payment.succeeded event and have an order marked paid.
A subscriber that fails still gets a 200 sent to Paylane, and the relay stores nothing, so the event is lost for that subscriber with only a log line.
Subscribers answer in up to 30 seconds one after another, past Paylane's 10-second limit, so Paylane resends the event and subscribers process it again with nothing to detect it.
